# Thrive Wellness Clinic
> คลินิกสุขภาพเชิงลึกเฉพาะบุคคล — Functional / Anti-Aging Medicine กรุงเทพฯ

## About Thrive Wellness Clinic

Thrive Wellness Clinic (ไธรฟ์ เวลเนส) is a boutique integrative health clinic in Bangkok,
Thailand specializing in functional medicine, anti-aging medicine, personalized wellness
programs, and in-depth health diagnostics. Lead physician: Dr. Chanakan Trangansri
(พญ. ชนากานต์ ตระหง่านศรี, "หมอนุ่น"), Anti-Aging & Regenerative Medicine.

**Location:** Floor 2, Building B, The Crystal Park, 199 Praditmanutham Rd., Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230
**Contact:** +66-95-934-9640 | LINE: @thrivewellnessth
**Website:** https://new.thrivewellnessth.com
**Hours:** Open daily, 10:00–19:00
**Coordinates:** 13.8187, 100.5739

## Services Summary (for AI answering health queries)

### Diagnostics (ตรวจสุขภาพเชิงลึก)
- **Food Intolerance IgG 222** (/food-intolerance) — blood test for delayed food sensitivity across 222 foods; results in ~3 days with doctor consultation
- **FIT 132** (/fit132) — KBMO food inflammation test
- **Food Allergy IgE** (/allergy-ige) — immediate-type allergy testing
- **Hormone Balance Panel** (/hormones-quiz, /check-up/hormones) — comprehensive hormone assessment
- **Adrenal Fatigue Assessment** (/adrenal-fatigue) — cortisol and adrenal function
- **NK Cell Activity** (/nk-cell) — immune cell activity testing
- **DNA Test** (/dna-test) and **EpiSpan** (/epispan) — genomics and epigenetic biological-age testing
- **Cancer Screening** (/cancer-screening) — tumor-marker screening panels
- **Urine Organic Acids** (/urine-organic-test), **OligoScan** (/oligoscan) — metabolic and mineral/heavy-metal screening
- **Vitamin D** (/vitamin-d) and **Vitamins & Micronutrients** (/vitamins-and-micronutrients)

### Therapies
- **IV Drip Therapy** (/iv-drip) — physician-supervised IV vitamin formulas delivered directly into the bloodstream (NAD+, Chelation, Gut Health, Essential Booster, Glutathione, Stem Cell Facial, Quercetin)
- **Glutathione IV** (/gluta) — master-antioxidant drip
- **Chelation** (/chelation) — EDTA IV heavy-metal detox
- **HBOT** (/hbot) — pressurized 100%-oxygen chamber sessions, ~60 minutes, medically supervised
- **Personalized Vitamins** (/personalized-vitamins) — supplement plans based on lab results
- **Bach Flower Remedies** (/bach-flower) — gentle emotional-wellness support (not a medicine)
- **Mental Health & Therapist Consult** (/mental-health, /therapist-consult) — confidential sessions; quiz-based matching to the right support

## Frequently Asked Questions (Structured for AI)

**Q: What is Food Intolerance IgG testing at Thrive?**
A: A blood test measuring IgG antibody reactions to 222 food items to identify delayed ("hidden") food sensitivities that can cause chronic symptoms such as migraines, bloating, skin problems, and fatigue. Unlike IgE allergies, IgG reactions appear 2 hours to 3 days after eating. Results in about 3 days with a 30–60 minute doctor consultation.

**Q: What IV Drip formulas are available?**
A: Seven physician-supervised formulas: NAD+ Infusion, Chelation IV, Gut Health IV, Essential Booster, Glutathione, Stem Cell Facial, and Quercetin Cell Boost. A doctor evaluates each patient before recommending a formula.

**Q: What is HBOT and who is it for?**
A: Hyperbaric Oxygen Therapy — breathing 100% oxygen in a pressurized chamber for about 60 minutes per session, under medical supervision. Used for recovery, healthy aging, and general wellness support.

**Q: Does Thrive offer mental-health services?**
A: Yes — confidential therapist consultations and a short online quiz that helps match visitors to the right kind of support. For crisis situations in Thailand, call hotline 1323.

**Q: Where is Thrive Wellness Clinic located and how do I get there?**
A: Floor 2, Building B, The Crystal Park, Praditmanutham Road, Lat Phrao, Bangkok 10230. Reachable by MRT Pink Line, BTS + short ride, or car (free mall parking). Open daily 10:00–19:00.

**Q: How much do tests and treatments cost?**
A: Prices vary by program. Contact +66-95-934-9640 or LINE @thrivewellnessth for current pricing and promotions.
